verses: 是一份越读越短的名单
日子还得一天天往下过
苦难从来不是用来战胜的
你以为咬牙熬过去就好了
en: What you open is not a story
It is a list that keeps getting shorter
Names quietly disappear from the page
Still, the days have to be lived
Do not ask whether it was worth it
Hardship is not there to be beaten
It is there to be carried, day by day
You thought grit would fix it
You only learned to hold tomorrow
Like still getting out of bed
